evidence: The initial stage of film growth on OH- and H-terminated Si surfaces is investigated using Rutherford backscattering spectrometry (RBS), x-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS), and spectroscopic ellipsometry (SE). Angle-resolved XPS measurements reveal the formation of an interfacial layer after four ALD cycles on the H-terminated surface. HRTEM data were provided by Evans analytical group. The interfacial layer thickness was verified using HRTEM and ARXPS measurements.
